item.title: Faster Speculative Decoding for Low-Resource Languages
item.description: arXiv:2501.00001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We speed up inference for Indic languages by drafting with a small multilingual model. Our method keeps generation quality while cutting latency by 40%.
item.dc:creator: Asha Rao, Dev Patel

item.title: KV Cache Compression via Structured Pruning
item.description: arXiv:2501.00002v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prune KV cache entries along attention heads, reducing memory during batched serving without quality loss.
item.dc:creator: Mei Lin
